findings.criterion: Coherent page-level frame across mixed forms, not type-driven unrelated edges
findings.renderEvidence: Aliyun sections reset their left edge with shape. ECS features/news step inward from site/table frame. Most clearly, Grafana banners sit 176px left of its toolbar and panel grid despite belonging to one compact dashboard region.
findings.sourceEvidence: Grafana source toolbar, banners and panel region share content origin x=336 (sidebar excluded). Aliyun source contains intentional bleed and inner columns; those must remain distinct from arbitrary width resets.
findings.geometryEvidence: 2560: narrow x=840,w=880; wide/site root x=664,w=1232. Grafana banners x=664,w=1232 vs toolbar/panels x=840,w=880. 1440 equivalents x=280 vs104. 390 all primary region frames x=16,w=358.
findings.improvementCriterion: Anchor connected mixed-form regions to one intentional page frame; permit source-supported inner columns/bleeds, rather than making every section the same width or blanket-centering brands. Recheck whole height at all four widths.

findings.criterion: Cohesive image/title/facts/actions; no uncontrolled oversized media
findings.renderEvidence: ECS technical architecture diagram becomes the first enormous full-viewport image, displacing product summary and purchase far below the title. Aliyun home globe image dominates its closing region; stats and CTA then hug viewport left while the following service region abruptly returns to a narrow inner frame.
findings.sourceEvidence: ECS source shows product heading/summary, buy+trial and offers before the compact architecture diagram in product introduction (source y≈1500–2300). Aliyun source globe/stats belong to one contained, centered infrastructure section. Full bleed is not intrinsically a defect, and no intrinsic-pixel upscaling was detected.
findings.geometryEvidence: ECS 2560 image x≈0,y=146.625,w=2559.969,h=1350.609; first following section y=1537.828; root buy y=2248.844. 1920 image h=1012.953;1440 h=759.719;390 h=205.75. Natural asset 4640×2448. Home infrastructure banner x=0,w=2560,h=1420.203; succeeding services x=840,w=880.
findings.improvementCriterion: Keep informational media within a justified shared frame and present product identity/summary/purchase as one visible group. Contain infrastructure facts/CTA with the image’s content edge. Do not solve via site CSS/model presentation flags or forced image enlargement.

findings.criterion: All modeled actions and faithful captured targets survive rendering
findings.renderEvidence: Seven model navigation destinations disappear completely. Render emits only radio label/value controls; it contains neither href nor any copy of those seven destination URLs. Facts-only fidelity reports 1.00 despite this loss.
findings.sourceEvidence: All seven target strings exist in source DOM/nodes (exact-string audit). Relative-anchor normalization alone is insufficient for the two source menu targets not represented as literal anchors; this finding is specifically MODEL→HTML target loss, not an unsupported-target allegation.
findings.geometryEvidence: All widths use the same HTML. Product tab strip remains within page geometry (zero overflow), which does not prove action preservation.
findings.improvementCriterion: Preserve each captured destination through shared closed-grammar control/axis decisions while keeping source tab semantics and compact utility density. Add a defect-detecting action-target preservation check independent of text fidelity.

findings.criterion: Foreground and surface must be paired for readable contrast
findings.renderEvidence: Pale captured dark-theme link color survives on a white rendered surface; both banners are visibly barely legible.
findings.sourceEvidence: Source is a dark Grafana dashboard; its light text is supported by dark surface. No requirement to replicate dark theme literally, but foreground cannot be transplanted independently of background.
findings.geometryEvidence: All widths: computed foreground rgb(204,204,220), effective background rgb(255,255,255), contrast ratio 1.5887≈1.59:1 at16px. Source dark banner/surrounding panel is visible in capture.
findings.improvementCriterion: Pair shared foreground/surface decisions; attain readable normal-size text contrast (4.5:1 diagnostic threshold), then visually recheck actual banners at each width without per-site escape hatches.

findings.criterion: One source utility control should remain one compact utility control
findings.renderEvidence: Renderer shows separate “Enter edit mode” and “Edit” pill controls for one source Edit button. Mobile wraps them as two controls, increasing utility height.
findings.sourceEvidence: source-excerpts.json proves one button: accessible name Enter edit mode, visible text Edit; bbox x1354,y64,w70,h32. Model carries name plus action label, not two distinct source actions.
findings.geometryEvidence: 2560 toolbar height77.906;390 height128.219. Four rendered pills from three modeled utility items. Source has one Edit button.
findings.improvementCriterion: Render this action-only item as a single control with correct visible label and retained accessible meaning; test shared decision/three-target consistency rather than changing facts to hide duplication.

findings.criterion: Readable nested pricing hierarchy, not DOM-depth-driven shrinkage
findings.renderEvidence: Section labels such as 信用卡和借记卡, 银行和其他支付方式, 争议, 争议受理费, Tax Basic details shrink to 10.72px despite governing16px body text and pricing. Long catalog needs a clear hierarchy, not smaller-and-smaller headings.
findings.sourceEvidence: Source uses compact product cards and distinct pricing columns. It is genuinely a long pricing catalog; long height alone and centered readable whitespace are not defects.
findings.geometryEvidence: 2560/1920/1440 render height17440;390 height23937. Nested H6 computed font10.72px; body16px; H4 product titles16px; outer H2 23.2px. Catalog depth-1 w880,h12437.453 atdesktop.
findings.improvementCriterion: Use a legible semantic type hierarchy for all catalog sections independent of model nesting depth; governed body text should not dwarf its headings. Preserve all prices and product distinctions; no arbitrary condensation or blanket card redesign.

findings.criterion: Action-only controls are utilities, not empty fact/definition rows
findings.renderEvidence: Contact sales appears as a bold definition heading followed by an empty .defval. Primary “立即开始” lives below the whole customer/document deflist. The contact target exists, but its control affordance is misleading and the CTA group is separated by unrelated fact rows.
findings.sourceEvidence: Source closing CTA pairs start/contact sales together, with customer/document utilities adjacent. The source action exists; this is not target loss and not a demand for source-specific styling.
findings.geometryEvidence: 2560 CTA x840,w880,y17062.359,h365.75; FAQ x664,w1232 before it. targeted-probes.json preserves exact .g-cta outerHTML with empty defval for contact sales.
findings.improvementCriterion: Keep action-only contact/start controls in a coherent compact action group using shared axis grammar; retain customer/doc facts as facts and every existing target. Recheck desktop/mobile grouping and no empty fact rows.

findings.criterion: Source-grounded targets; do not invent action destinations
findings.renderEvidence: Root buy and four instance buy links render to www.aliyun.com/product/ecs/buy and invented-looking spec=e/u2a/c9i/g9i routes absent from both source DOM and nodes.
findings.sourceEvidence: Captured root href is https://ecs-buy.aliyun.com/buyRedirect.htm?period=1&periodType=Yearly. Captured offer buttons are <button>立即购买</button> with no href; absence of captured destination is not authority to synthesize spec routes. News target is not included in this allegation (target string is captured although not a literal anchor).
findings.geometryEvidence: Same five incorrect/unsupported URLs at all widths; href target checks distinguish MODEL→RENDER preservation from SOURCE→MODEL fidelity.
findings.improvementCriterion: Restore exact captured root destination; remove unsupported per-instance destinations or replace only with capture-proven targets. Preserve targetless controls without fabricated URLs; add target-integrity regression proof.

findings.criterion: Pricing includes source billing period/qualifiers, not bare misleading amounts
findings.renderEvidence: Offers display bare ¥99,¥1438.68,¥3459.9 with no annual duration; source purchase period and ￥99.00/1年起 qualifier are intentionally not modeled, according to current _intent. Amount fidelity1.00 does not prove offer fidelity.
findings.sourceEvidence: Source nodes contain visible 购买时长 : 1年 at x248,y613,w184,h28 (and corresponding offer lines); current _intent itself records e ￥99.00/1年起, u2a￥1438.68/1年, c9i￥3459.90/1年. No price should be invented for g9i.
findings.geometryEvidence: At390 visible comparison crop shows bare e/u2a price strings; same model at all widths. Source duration provenance retained in source-excerpts.json.
findings.improvementCriterion: Retain annual billing period and “起” where captured through an existing allowed fact/qualifier representation (no new presentation key); retain original amounts and genuine g9i price gap. Validate source/model/render offer semantics, not only amount strings.
